overview: Finalize the simulation loop by implementing deterministic state hashing for save/load integrity, optimizing the tick-based physics solver for zero-allocation stability, and compressing the storyteller's narrative state into a bit-packed format. These steps ensure 100% coverage of the endgame phase with minimal memory footprint.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Hasher
tasks.acceptance_criteria:
1. Hash value is stable across multiple runs for identical state.
2. No dynamic memory allocation occurs during hashing.
3. Unit tests verify collision resistance for 10k random states.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Ensures save/load consistency and prevents desyncs in long-running simulations.

tasks.title: Optimize Tick-Based Solver with Fixed-Point Arithmetic
tasks.acceptance_criteria:
1. Physics steps are deterministic across platforms.
2. No floating-point drift after 10,000 ticks.
3. Performance benchmark shows >20% speedup over double-precision.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Provides snappier, more predictable physics interactions in dense scenes.

tasks.title: Bit-Packed Narrative State Compression
tasks.acceptance_criteria:
1. State fits in 6 bytes.
2. Unpack/Repack cycle preserves all data.
3. Memory usage reduced by 60% compared to struct padding.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster save/load times and smaller save files for large worlds.
